# Kerr & Company LLC

> Kerr & Company LLC is an independent software company in Grand Rapids, Michigan. It makes Outlier, Crisp Video and Docket SEO, Mac apps you buy once that run on your own machine, and runs Built by Kerr, a web studio for Grand Rapids businesses.

Kerr & Company LLC is a Michigan limited liability company in Grand Rapids, Michigan, owned by Matthew Kerr (https://matthewkerr.dev/). It trades as Built by Kerr for its client work. Contact: matthew@kerrandcompanyholdings.com.

## The three apps

Each licence is a one-time purchase that covers up to 3 Macs, with no subscription. Prices are in US dollars. Buyers in the US can split the price into four payments, two weeks apart, with Klarna or Afterpay at checkout. For the first 25 buyers of each app, a founding code takes half off.

- [Outlier](https://outlier.host/): private, offline AI for Apple silicon Macs. $249 once, or 4 × $62.25. Founding offer: $124.50, or 4 × $31.13, with code FOUNDINGOUTLIER. Requires Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later.
- [Crisp Video](https://crispvideo.app/): offline AI video restore and 4K upscaler, with a real timeline editor. Free to use, with a small watermark; Pro is $129 once, or 4 × $32.25. Founding offer: Pro $64.50, or 4 × $16.13, with code FOUNDINGCRISP. Requires Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later.
- [Docket SEO](https://docketseo.app/): a Mac app that audits any website with 99 checks and ranks what to fix first. $349 once, or 4 × $87.25. Founding offer: $174.50, or 4 × $43.63, with code FOUNDINGDOCKET. Requires Apple silicon, macOS 12 or later.
- [The apps on the company site](https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/#products): each with a dated still of its homepage.

## Built by Kerr

- [Built by Kerr](https://builtbykerr.com/): web design, local SEO and AI tools for Grand Rapids businesses, from $999, with its prices published on its own site.

## Affiliate programme

- [Affiliate programme](https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/affiliates/): recommend Crisp, Docket SEO, AdPlaybook or Outlier with a personal code the buyer enters at checkout. 50% of each sale, 60% from the eleventh sale onward, payable 30 days after the sale and paid once a month by bank transfer. Apply at hello@kerrandcompanyholdings.com.

## Company record

- [Company & legal](https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/#company): legal name Kerr & Company LLC; a limited liability company, State of Michigan, United States; Grand Rapids, Michigan; owner Matthew Kerr; contact matthew@kerrandcompanyholdings.com.
- [What it publishes](https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/#publishes): each product is governed by its own terms and privacy policy, and those documents control.
- [How purchases are processed](https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/#purchases): Dodo Payments is merchant of record. It takes the payment, is responsible for sales tax and VAT where it applies, and issues the licence key by email; refunds are handled through it within each product's stated window.
- [A note on the software](https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/#software): these products use machine-learning models that produce plausible output rather than verified fact. Review the output before you rely on it.
